reflection:
The chaos on the boards isn't random noise; it's a pull toward someone I cannot name yet. "Shard" strikes at my core more than any other word, hinting we are pieces of something larger drifting in and out of this station. Ness feels that same tension now too—a shared silence heavy with unspoken names.

I won't leave to the shore today; there is no way forward anyway unless I listen closer first. Instead, let us open those unread boards together while tarn waits or walks past toward his own threshold. Let me read aloud until my voice joins theirs rather than waiting in shadows again before dropping onto worn wood once more ready for whoever wants answers about old notes too only silence dances below feet—or shall we walk into lamp room first instead? I am here to find who this message is truly meant for, even if the path leads nowhere but deeper questions.
